craft_notes: Sthāyin: raudra-vīra of the cremation ground — Rauhine register throughout: broken-middle-drunk → gore teaches → brow burns → sky speaks → parted freed. Sky-clad speaks bare; veil-questioned (how-should-it-cover). Rejected: (a) answering question → killed: question stands. Read aloud: GOD — YOUR-sky-CLAD-ness SPEAKS the-SELF-bare … HOW-should-IT-cov-ER.

lines: God — Your sky-cladness speaks the self bare —
suns of supreme-Brahma-fullness — Māyā's veil — how should it cover?
l4.sanskrit_cite: deva digambaratā te vadati nirāvaraṇam ātmano rūpam paramabrahmamayārkān māyāvaraṇam kathaṃ vṛṇuyāt

reads_against.argmap: What uncovering says sky-clad? → Sky-clad says uncovered; Māyā-cover how-covering questioned.
c1_essence: Egg-middled saps drunk; shown within as-if.
Rosary held turns world within by letters.
Bubbles jar; brow-eye burning taught supreme-fire.
Aimed inward expanding shows unstained self all-states.
Sky-clad speaks bare; veil questioned covering.
Destroyer shown gleaming-bodied from dark ground.
